entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Makoto

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Right!?

entries.en: Oh, right!
Let's try it out.

entries.en: Oh...

entries.en: This is a greater problem than[n]simply finding their keywords.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: Unless you have any[n]more ideas, Ryuji?

entries.speaker: Yusuke

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Our reputation's gonna plummet[n]if we don't face this shit.

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: That is true. If we remain silent,[n]people would believe we simply[n]chose to run away from the matter.

entries.speaker: Makoto
entries.en: Medjed has taunted us[n]publicly, after all...

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: If they are criminals, we[n]cannot just let them be.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: And we don't have any other[n]targets right now either.

Let's do that.

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Ryuji

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: If we can change Medjed's heart, it'll[n]most definitely affect Mementos.
